The plate is square, about 22 cm across. It holds cantaloupe chunks, roasted potatoes, a few sausage slices, and scrambled egg whites. A bowl of soup sits partly out of frame, so I excluded it.

Estimated portions:
- Cantaloupe: about 6 pieces, roughly 100 g and 35 kcal.
- Roasted potatoes: about 10 cubes, roughly 110 g and 150 kcal including oil.
- Sausage (chorizo): about 3 slices, roughly 25 g and 90 kcal.
- Egg whites: roughly 130 g and 70 kcal. They look fluffy, so possibly with a little added fat.

Total mass is about 365 g and total energy is about 345 kcal. I'll put it slightly higher, at about 350 kcal.
